title: Plant Wide & Device Run Mode Trend

fields.latestPosition: Added to plant shutdown list - Kayne 29/10/2025
fields.nextAction: Confirm which shutdown this is scheduled into
fields.why: When investigating why a process interlock did not trip a device, it presently has to be inferred through trending the alarms in the event tab versus drive status to see whether a device was running in auto, local or manual mode. This makes finding process interlock faults difficult to assess if they are properly actuating a stop signal or has been bypassed through running the device in local/manual. Implementing a trend for run mode for each device would mean clarity into plant control & cause location.
fields.design:
Implement a new trendable tag for each device that monitors device run mode similar to the device status tag
*XX_STS_N -> Drive Status
e.g.
*XX_RMD_N – Drive Run Mode

Where the tag variable gets updated each time the run mode changes:
1 = Local Mode
2 = Manual Mode
3 = Auto

Similar to XX_STS_N code rungs:
[Image in form – see source document]
fields.impact: Engineers and metallurgists can trend device run mode for root cause analysis.
